@@ -2,51 +2,63 @@
 
 init() {
   SCRIPT_DIR="$(dirname "$0")"
-  BRANCH="master"
-  PROVIDER="github"
-  DRY_RUN=0
 }
 
 run() {
-  build_cmd
+  build_cmdline
   if [ $DRY_RUN -eq 1 ]; then
-    echo $CMD
+    echo $CMDLINE
   else
-    echo $CMD >&2
-    $CMD
+    echo $CMDLINE >&2
+    $CMDLINE
   fi
 }
 
-build_cmd() {
+build_cmdline() {
+  if [ -n "$(command -v curld)" ]; then
+    CMD="curl -fsSL"
+  elif [ -n "$(command -v wget)" ]; then
+    CMD="wget -O- -q"
+  else
+    echo no downloader found! Please install either wget or curl.
+    exit 1
+  fi
+
   case "$PROVIDER" in
+  chisel)
+    CMDLINE="$CMD https://chiselapp.com/user/$USER/repository/$REPO/raw?ci=$BRANCH&filename=$FILE"
+    ;;
   github)
-    CMD="curl -fsSL https://raw.github.com/$REPO/$BRANCH/$FILE"
+    CMDLINE="$CMD https://raw.github.com/$USER/$REPO/$BRANCH/$FILE"
     ;;
   gitlab)
-    CMD="curl -fsSL https://gitlab.com/$REPO/-/blob/$BRANCH/$FILE"
+    CMDLINE="$CMD https://gitlab.com/$USER/$REPO/-/blob/$BRANCH/$FILE"
     ;;
   bitbucket)
-    CMD="curl -fsSL https://bitbucket.org/$REPO/raw/$BRANCH/$FILE"
+    CMDLINE="$CMD https://bitbucket.org/$USER/$REPO/raw/$BRANCH/$FILE"
     ;;
   esac
 }
 
 usage() {
   echo "Usage:"
-  echo "  getraw [options] <username>/<repository>/[path/]<file>"
+  echo "  getraw [options] <username>/<repository>/[<path>/]<file>"
   echo ""
   echo "Options:"
   echo "  -b, --branch=<branch>      Use <branch> instead of master branch"
   echo "  -d, --dry-run              Only prints the curl command line and exits"
   echo "  -h, --help                 Display this help message"
-  # echo "  -p, --provider=<provider>  Use SCM <provider>, default is github, valid"
-  # echo "                             providers are github, gitlab, bitbucket"
+  echo "  -p, --provider=<provider>  Use SCM <provider>, default is github, supported"
+  echo "                             providers are chisel, github, gitlab, bitbucket"
   exit 1
 }
 
 parse_args() {
   local USAGE=0
 
+  PROVIDER="github"
+  DRY_RUN=0
+
   while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
     case "$1" in
     --help | -h)
@@ -59,12 +71,20 @@ parse_args() {
       shift
       BRANCH="$1"
       ;;
+    --provider=*)
+      PROVIDER="${1#*=}"
+      ;;
+    -p)
+      shift
+      PROVIDER="$1"
+      ;;
     --dry-run | -d)
       DRY_RUN=1
       ;;
     *)
       if [ -z $REPO ]; then
-        REPO=$(echo $1 | cut -d/ -f1-2)
+        USER=$(echo $1 | cut -d/ -f1)
+        REPO=$(echo $1 | cut -d/ -f2)
         FILE=$(echo $1 | cut -d/ -f3-)
       else
         echo "to many arguments: $1"
@@ -75,6 +95,17 @@ parse_args() {
     shift
   done
 
+  if [ -z $BRANCH ]; then
+    case "$PROVIDER" in
+    chisel)
+      BRANCH="trunk"
+      ;;
+    *)
+      BRANCH="master"
+      ;;
+    esac
+  fi
+
   if [ -z "$REPO" ] || [ -z "$FILE" ]; then
     echo "Missing arguments!"
     USAGE=1
